title: High-Pressure BaMgF$_{4}$ Structure
comments:
This is the high pressure structure of BaMgF$_{4}$, stable above 5 GPa. Below that pressure it is in the \href{current_web_home_dir/AB4C_oC24_36_a_4a_a-002}{BaZnF$_{4}$ structure}. (Posse, 2011) 
 The data shown here was taken at 6.08 GPa.
